Class PlayerView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.view.smallModel.PlayerView
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerView extends Object implements Serializable
A lightweight representation of a player's state used by the client-side UI. It contains the nickname, assigned color, current resources, and owned cards. Provides helper methods to compute aggregate stats like characters held, discounts, and points.
